health hacks that make me
feel alive again

water with intention

i keep a full glass of water next to me and finish it before every meal. it's the easiest habit i've ever started, and my energy in the afternoon is completely different.

outside before my phone

i step outside for five minutes before i look at my phone each morning. fresh air and daylight first, messages second, and the whole morning feels calmer and slower.

tiny rests

every couple of hours i close my eyes for two minutes and just breathe. it feels like nothing, but those tiny pauses stop the afternoon crash before it ever arrives.

something new every day

i learn something new every day in 5 minutes: a planet, a famous artist, a moment in history. feeling curious again was the part of being alive i didn't know i'd lost.

a walk after dinner

i go for a slow 15 minute walk after dinner, whatever the weather. it helps digestion, clears my head, and gives the evening a calm ending instead of more screen time.
